detail.title: Kernel Governance and Durable Record Mechanisms for WAKE Process Continuity
detail.summary: WAKE maintains process continuity through a specialized kernel architecture that separates untrusted proposal inputs from authoritative record state. The system is designed to favor complete transaction integrity over partial availability, preventing inconsistent state drift across model invocations.
